semiconductor_relevance: High — Nakajima Chemicals specializes in resin materials and processing specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Nakajima Chemicals Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company with over 130 years of experience, focusing on high-quality resin materials for the semiconductor industry. They provide a range of products including thermosetting resin laminated boards and high-precision processed products tailored to customer needs.
capabilities: High-precision thickness processing with ±0.01 mm tolerance
